doc.title: Wilson "Chembo" Corniel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019

title: Studying Latin music by listening and playing, and its many styles
summary: Learning requires both listening and playing; Latin music has big band, conjunto, charanga, son montuno and trio branches, and Cugat is called a commercial bridge.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
